notes: Rules implemented as specified (overnight/London levels, midpoint bias at the RTH open, biased-side stop entry, mid stop capped 0.4 ATR, 0.5x-range target, noon flat). MNQ and MES are dead: default PF 0.84 / 0.74 on MAIN, 0.83 / 0.79 on PRIOR; 32-cell grid: MNQ 4/32 cells positive (PF <= 1.08, 39% win, largest day 50-80% of net), MES 0/32. The directional statistic is real on our data (biased ON level breaks first 70-75% of RTH sessions, 2015-2026) but the break is shallow: after the first break the excursion reaches 0.5x range only 40-47% of the time while the midpoint is revisited 53-57% -> mid-stop vs 0.5x target is a ~1:1 payoff at ~45% win = negative after costs. MGC: every one of the 32 MAIN cells is positive (default PF 1.44, 211 trades, Sharpe 1.64, both sides profitable) but every PRIOR cell is negative (PF 0.60-0.92) and the default rule lost in 9 of 12 years 2015-2026; 2026 alone is $5.3k of the $6.1k MAIN net; the Lucid MC on MAIN still has NEGATIVE expected net per evaluation at every size (best 10 micros: pass 0.21, P(first payout) 0.03, -$44/eval) because the $150-450 loss days under the $2k EOD-trailing MLL dominate. Second pass (gap_min 0.003, outside_mode pullback, last_entry 10:00) does not rescue MNQ and does not make MGC positive on PRIOR. Gold edge = 2025-26 regime, not a robust rule.

verify.lookahead_notes: No material look-ahead. ON levels (18:00->08:19) and ATR (daily RTH, shift(1)) are strictly prior to the first RTH bar; order placed at i0 as a stop at level+/-2 ticks. Technicality: the bias uses the OPEN of bar i0 (the bar the order goes live on) rather than the close of i0-1; no fill advantage (stop fills at max(open,level)+slip, outside days skipped). Scratch variant with bias from close of i0-1: MAIN PF 1.422->1.411, PRIOR identical (0.744). Strict fix: use df1.close[i0-1] of the same day_id for o0.
verify.thin_session_dependence: Top-10 days = 68.8% of MAIN net (+4,098 of +5,959); largest day 9.8%; largest month 2026-07 = 28.9% (no month > 40%); 2026 alone = 89% of net (2025 PF 1.10); all edge in 08:20-08:59 entries (+6,580 on 114 trades; 09:xx -19, 10:xx -602).
verify.notes: Reproduces: MAIN PF 1.42/210 trades, robust to slip 2 (1.39) and to all 14 single-parameter neighbours (>=1.22). Fails history: 2015-2022 PF 0.86 (0.80 ex-2020), losing in 7 of 8 years, PRIOR 2023-24 PF 0.74, all 32 PRIOR grid cells negative. WF OOS 2025 PF 1.27 passes but Lucid MC on the OOS stream has exp_net_lb -146 at every size, not recommended. One criterion missed by a wide margin -> dead.
